question:

1) The circle element shift clockwise subsequently.

2) No change in the square element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/943b4ca9034c472b3a906740cb7c0e0fdf02d1ed6a8d0f4b09e8abd410343df7.png]
